query: with e as ( insert into lineage.event (run_id, event_type, event_time, payload) values ($1, $2, $3, $4) returning event_id) insert into lineage.event_dataset (event_id, direction, ordinal, namespace, name) select e.event_id, d.direction, d.ordinal, d.namespace, d.name from e, ( select 'input' as direction, ord as ordinal, ns as namespace, nm as name from unnest($5::text[], $6::text[]) with ordinality as t(ns, nm, ord) union all select 'output', ord, ns, nm from unnest($7::text[], $8::text[]) with ordinality as t(ns, nm, ord)) d
